# Copilot instructions

- Project: Vite + React + TypeScript PWA
- App name: Bobs Archiv Das ???-Fallometer
- Goal: mobile-first radioplay rating app with offline support for iOS
- Storage: localStorage for ratings and notes
- PWA files: `public/manifest.webmanifest`, `public/sw.js`, `public/logo.jpeg`
- Build command: `npm run build`
- Development command: `npm run dev`

## Notes
- Keep the UI responsive and touch-friendly.
- Preserve offline support and iOS meta tags.
- Replace the placeholder icon artwork when final branding is available.
